question: Does healthy release qualification reject the known delayed-press failure while allowing a subsequent new press?
method: Nine bounded traces: 20/50/80 ms debounce and three presses before fault clearance
stop_condition: Run declared traces once; retain unverified analog timer and asynchronous timing scope
criteria: Enable after healthy stable release and new press
limitations: Raw input conditioning and real timing not implemented
No exhaustive analog or component fault proof
